content: Betting journal table stakes: log every bet with date, market, odds, stake, result; ROI = settled profit / settled stakes with pending and voided bets excluded from denominators; units staked/won, bankroll curve, profit calendar, drawdown periods (max peak-to-trough), win rate, average odds, longest losing streak, ROI segmented by bet type/odds range, CLV trend over time. Flat-unit vs Kelly sizing tracked as separate series/strategies. Differentiators: tilt/bounce-back detection, sample-size honesty gates (metrics hidden below N bets), CLV-per-bet. Anti-patterns: showing profit without denominators, counting voided/pending in ROI, claiming future returns.
